title: UMD complexity review: Dagster + Hatchet dual-orchestration is redundant in v1
body: Complexity review of the proposed Universal Media Decomposer API architecture (Option A). Finding F1 (MEDIUM confidence): Dagster is retained as a DAG/lineage declaration layer while Hatchet is the sole runner and Dagster auto-materialize/schedulers are disabled in production. The §16 lineage information Dogster would provide already exists twice: Hatchet DAG parents edges and stage-manifest input_refs/evidence_refs. Recommendation to DDAuthor: drop Dogster from v1, derive the invalidation lineage table from the single Hatchet DAG definition, reintroduce asset-freshness tooling only behind the projection interface when measured. Full review: artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-complexity-review.md

title: UMD complexity review: optional graph/RDF projections should be fenced out of v1 footprint
body: Finding F2 (MEDIUM-HIGH confidence): the architecture-options ownership map, repo structure, and footprint estimate (18-24 packages) carry Neo4j graph and RDF claim-graph projections into the first release, but the design's own evidence (technology-research §1.2/§6: relational + bounded recursive CTE suffices for first release; §18 permits typed REST with no graph engine; T4 C-as-projection is deferred) supports v1 = typed REST query over Postgres + pgvector + tsvector/pg_trgm only. Keep ProjectionBuilder/VectorIndex/query-adapter interfaces as contracts; implement graph/RDF builders only on a measured trigger (unbounded path traversal or RDF interop requirement). Full review: artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-complexity-review.md

title: UMD complexity review: event-sourced ledger is the simplest correct design, keep it
body: Finding (justified complexity, HIGH confidence): the event-sourced semantic ledger + Tier-0/Tier-1 projection split is the simplest correct design for Task.md §2/§7/§15/§21/§29, not the most elaborate. Documented alternatives (mutable Neo4j+changelog, XTDB bitemporal, RDF co-authority) were rejected on evidence (Overeem 8/19 abandonment; Nat Pryce dual-write postmortem). The design draws the right event boundary (semantics in log; deterministic derived evidence in typed tables/OCFL, not events) and the single shared reduce_current_state function correctly collapses Tier-0/Tier-1 divergence risk into one implementation. DDAuthor should resist any 'simplify to direct relational + audit table' argument. Full review: artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-complexity-review.md
